decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message requirement that relevant images be added before publication; the internal-link details do not change it.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records that publication occurs after images and internal links are added.
Using relevant keywords to select internal links does not change the approved blog keyword list or replacement rule.
The publication prerequisite for internal links does not change the workflow for proposing blog topics.
The source decision concerns links within blog articles and does not alter campaign keyword selection or page mapping.
The internal-link publication condition does not affect the requirement to provide keyword search-volume data.
The source decision applies to blog internal links and does not change the separate webpage replacement text.
Internal links within blog articles are distinct from the off-page backlink quantity and follow-type requirements.
